entries.title: The card that asks to use a secret is easier to read
entries.body: When a task asks to use one of your secrets, its card now shows one fact per row: each secret and where it goes, the command and its folder, and the task's reason in quotes. A line beside each allow says what it covers, and Don't allow stands apart from the two allows.

picture.alt: The card asking to give a secret to a task, with labelled rows for the secret, the command, its folder and the reason, and a line beside each allow
